config.heading: About BookMarketing Pro
config.subheading: We're a team of passionate book marketing specialists dedicated to helping authors succeed.

config.heading: Our Story
config.text: BookMarketing Pro was founded in 2013 by a group of publishing industry veterans who saw a gap in the market. Authors were writing incredible books, but struggling to get them in front of readers. We built a full-service marketing agency dedicated exclusively to books and authors. Today, we've helped over 500 authors across every genre reach their sales goals.

items.question: How long have you been in business?
items.answer: BookMarketing Pro has been serving authors since 2013, with over a decade of experience in the book marketing industry.

items.question: What genres do you specialize in?
items.answer: We work with authors across all genres including fiction, non-fiction, romance, thriller, self-help, business, and more.

items.question: Do you work with self-published authors?
items.answer: Absolutely! A significant portion of our clients are indie and self-published authors. We tailor our strategies to your specific situation and budget.

items.question: Is there a contract?
items.answer: All plans are month-to-month. You can cancel anytime with 30 days notice. We also offer 6-month and annual packages with a discount.

items.question: What's included in the free consultation?
items.answer: A 30-minute call with one of our marketing strategists to discuss your book, your goals, and which plan makes the most sense for you.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee on all new plans if you're not satisfied with our onboarding process.

items.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
items.answer: Yes, you can change your plan at any time. Changes take effect at the start of the next billing cycle.

config.heading: Not Sure Which Plan is Right for You?
config.subtext: Book a free 30-minute consultation and we'll help you choose the best plan for your goals and budget.
